title: Levels plan cards
description: A warm off-white section: a big heading and lead, a pale green bordered strip with a green tracked eyebrow, a sentence and an ink button with an arrow, then three equal-height plan cards — white, pale green with a green border and soft shadow, and near-black — each with a small icon and pill badge, a title, grey text, a large price with a small period, a full-width button, tracked group labels over check lists, and a hairline footer with a link and a small perk line.
notes: tone picks each card's look: plain, featured (recommended) or dark (a .dark scope)
footers line up because each card's list grows to fill
